text: The corporate governance frameworks developed in the 2000s had little or no impact on the performance of listed companies during the financial crisis, and the number, scale, and effects of corporate scandals are not diminishing.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176

isBasedOn.name: The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies

abstract: Contemporary corporate governance frameworks developed in the 2000s had little or no impact on the performance of listed companies during the last financial crisis. Moreover, the number, scale, and effects of corporate scandals and economic failures do not appear to be diminishing.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: listed companies during the 2008 financial crisis
